struct Subject
  std::string account
  std::string program
struct Scope
  std::vector<std::string> targets
  std::vector<std::string> consumers
struct Metadata
  std::string name
  std::string kind
  std::string revision
  std::string state
  Scope scope
  Subject registered_by
  std::string registered
  std::string expires
  std::string header
  std::string last_applied
struct Registration
  std::string name
  std::string kind
  Scope scope
  std::string expires
  std::string header
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> secret
struct Rotation
  std::string name
  std::string expires
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> secret
struct StoreResult
  StoreOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
  std::optional<Metadata> current
struct RotateResult
  RotateOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
  std::optional<Metadata> current
struct RevokeResult
  RevokeOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
struct Limits
  std::int64_t max_credentials
  std::int64_t max_secret_bytes
  std::int64_t tombstone_retention_ms
  std::int64_t audit_retention_ms
  std::int64_t audit_capacity
  std::string secure_store
  std::vector<std::string> supported_kinds
struct MetadataPage
  PageOutcome outcome
  Limits limits
  std::vector<Metadata> records
  std::string next
  bool complete
struct AuditEntry
  std::int64_t sequence
  std::string time
  std::string event
  std::string name
  std::string revision
  std::optional<Subject> subject
  std::string consumer
  std::string target
  std::string outcome
struct AuditPage
  PageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<AuditEntry> entries
  std::string next
  bool at_end
struct Use
  Subject subject
  std::string consumer
  std::string name
  std::string target
  std::string challenge
struct CredentialResource
  std::string name
struct CheckResult
  ApplyOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
struct ApplyResult
  ApplyOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
  std::map<std::string, std::string> headers
struct SecretValue
  std::string name
  std::string revision
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> secret
struct SecretReadResult
  SecretReadOutcome outcome
  std::optional<SecretValue> value
struct MetadataReadResult
  MetadataReadOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Metadata> current
inline std::string encode(const Registration& v)
inline Registration decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
inline std::string service_name(std::string_view frame)
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct Holder
  virtual StoreResult store(const std::string& expected_revision, const Registration& registration)
  virtual RotateResult rotate(const std::string& expected_revision, const Rotation& rotation)
  virtual RevokeResult revoke(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name)
  virtual MetadataPage list(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual AuditPage audit(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_entries)
template<class Transport>struct HolderClient : Holder
  Transport& transport_
  StoreResult store(const std::string& expected_revision, const Registration& registration) override
  RotateResult rotate(const std::string& expected_revision, const Rotation& rotation) override
  RevokeResult revoke(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name) override
  MetadataPage list(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  AuditPage audit(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_entries) override
struct HolderService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct HolderDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Holder& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct Applier
  virtual CheckResult check(const Use& usage)
  virtual ApplyResult apply(const Use& usage)
template<class Transport>struct ApplierClient : Applier
  Transport& transport_
  CheckResult check(const Use& usage) override
  ApplyResult apply(const Use& usage) override
struct ApplierService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability

  Applier& handler

  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override

struct ScopedHolder
  virtual StoreResult store(const std::string& expected_revision, const Registration& registration)
  virtual RotateResult rotate(const std::string& expected_revision, const Rotation& rotation)
  virtual RevokeResult revoke(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name)
  virtual MetadataReadResult metadata(const std::string& name)
template<class Transport>struct ScopedHolderClient : ScopedHolder
  Transport& transport_
  StoreResult store(const std::string& expected_revision, const Registration& registration) override
  RotateResult rotate(const std::string& expected_revision, const Rotation& rotation) override
  RevokeResult revoke(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name) override
  MetadataReadResult metadata(const std::string& name) override

  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability

  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
